description.value: Delicia Cafe & Bakery is a specialty coffee shop and scratch bakery on Columbia Street in downtown New Westminster, founded by owners with 15 years of cafe experience in Australia. The menu spans house-roasted espresso blends sourced in partnership with Vancouver's Agro Roasters, freshly baked croissants, pastries, gelato, and a broad range of vegan and gluten-free items. Pets are welcome on the patio and the space doubles as an event venue for personal and corporate gatherings.

address.value: 656 Columbia St, New Westminster, BC V3M 1A9

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 11m; stands at 38m; rack at 56m; rack at 96m.
